description: Source code for a Program Enrollment Tool in ERPNext, handling student enrollment processes including fetching students and enrolling them.

classes.name: ProgramEnrollmentTool
classes.description: A Document class for managing program enrollment operations in ERPNext.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads and sets the 'academic_term_reqd' setting on document load.

methods.name: get_students
methods.description: Fetches students based on specified criteria, either from applicants or existing program enrollments, excluding inactive students.

methods.name: enroll_students
methods.description: Enrolls selected students into a program, creating new enrollment documents or calling an API for applicants.
